leftCard.subtitle: HAVE ANY QUESTIONS?
leftCard.title: We're Here To Help You
leftCard.paragraph: Find quick answer to common questions, about our freight and logistic services.

faqs.question: What happens if my shipment is delayed or lost?
faqs.answer: In the rare case of a delay or loss, our team immediately investigates the issue and keeps you updated in real time. Every shipment is covered by insurance and handled using strict procedures to ensure your goods stay safe and secure throughout the journey.

faqs.question: What is last-mile delivery and why is it important?
faqs.answer: Last-mile delivery is the final step that moves your parcel from our local distribution hub directly to the customer's door. It is important because it is the most visible part of the delivery experience and has a direct impact on customer satisfaction and on-time performance.

faqs.question: How can I reduce my transportation costs?
faqs.answer: Consolidating shipments, planning ahead for non-urgent cargo, and choosing the right freight mode for each load can significantly reduce your transportation spend. Our logistics experts can review your supply chain and recommend the most cost-effective options.

faqs.question: How do you ensure the safety and security of goods in transit?
faqs.answer: We use secure packaging, GPS-enabled tracking, sealed containers and trained handling staff at every stage. High-value shipments can also be insured and monitored around the clock for complete peace of mind.

faqs.question: Do you offer both domestic and international shipping?
faqs.answer: Yes. We provide door-to-door domestic courier services as well as international freight solutions by road, air, ocean and rail, backed by a strong global partner network.

faqs.question: How can I track my shipment in real time?
faqs.answer: Every shipment is assigned a unique tracking number. Simply enter it on our tracking page or app to view live location updates, estimated delivery time and complete movement history.

faqs.question: Which items are prohibited from shipping?
faqs.answer: Hazardous materials, flammable goods, illegal substances, perishables without proper clearance and other restricted items cannot be shipped. Please contact our support team if you are unsure whether your goods are safe to transport.

faqs.question: How is the shipping cost calculated?
faqs.answer: Shipping cost depends on the weight, dimensions, destination and delivery speed you choose. Use our instant quote tool or contact our team for a detailed, transparent price estimate with no hidden charges.

faqs.question: Do you provide warehousing and storage solutions?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer secure, climate-controlled warehousing with real-time inventory management so your goods stay organized and ready for dispatch whenever you need them.

faqs.question: How long does customs clearance usually take?
faqs.answer: Customs clearance typically takes one to three business days when all documentation is complete. Our dedicated customs team prepares and verifies every form in advance to minimize delays at the border.
